items.description: A timeless upright bonsai. Symmetrical, balanced, serene.
A soft blanket of emerald moss settles around your bonsai.
A smooth, grey stone worn by centuries of water.
Tall green stalks that sway in the wind. A symbol of resilience.
A traditional Tōrō lantern. Warm light glows through the window.
A pure white flower rising from still water.
The cascade style mimics a tree growing on a cliff, plunging downward.
Raked white sand with a single stone. Contemplation made visible.
A small pond with two koi gliding beneath the surface.
A dwarf pine with dark needles. Dignified and ancient.
A circular stone gate framing the garden beyond.
A five-tier pagoda tucked in the corner. Peace emanates from it.
Tubular chimes that sing with the breeze. Each note is a day sober.
Shaped by a lifetime of wind. Every branch tells a story of endurance.
